title: What Is AWS Transform MGN?
note: Lesson 2.1 addition for task 2.1 questions (K08, distractor for q-saa-2-1-k08-mc/mr): fetched from docs.aws.amazon.com and confirmed the service (still commonly called AWS Application Migration Service / MGN, matching the SAA-C03 exam guide) rehosts physical, virtual, and cloud servers onto AWS via continuous block-level replication, converting them for launch on AWS with minimal downtime and no container image produced. Flag: the page has been rebranded in the console/docs to "AWS Transform MGN"; the lesson keeps the exam-guide name "AWS Application Migration Service (MGN)" since that is the term SAA-C03 uses, but a maintainer may want to add the new name as a synonym.
